node.title: Plus-branch admissible F2 direct-sum reduction to prime-field GRS kernels
node.statement: At every official n=2^41 admissible row q=p^e<2^256 in the plus branch p=1 mod 4, ord_n(p)=2^D with D<=2. Every deployed antipodal window splits into at most four F_p-proportionality classes, and its F2 dual kernel is the direct sum of class kernels that are explicit prime-field [S,S-R,R+1]_p GRS/MDS codes. Consequently dim_Fp L=C min(S,R) exactly and the ternary mass factorizes as Z(L)=Z_1^C. The trace collapse uses ord_n(p), not e, and all K1 kernel/mass statements are invariant under the rules-level domain coset. No claim is made for p=3 mod 4 rows.
